data.body: 591d held-out validation: corrected two oracle defects (global git-email inheritance and over-specified internal wording), then 23/23 full-oracle cases passed. Defect-seeded mutations proved teeth: bypassing identity refusal failed 2/2 missing-email cases; dropping created-OID comparison failed 2/2 same-reason replacement cases; ignoring release=False failed 2/2 CAS-miss cases. Independent five-axis review found one required continuity issue: four legacy fsck held-out tests still referenced removed _reconciler_pause. Updated them to patch the provider-neutral context seam; focused repair/bridge/legacy suite now 108 passed. No remaining old pause-helper or gh workflow-disable/enable references under src/tests/release notes.
